verbalization: Abiesadine J is shown to have a target relationship with Guanine nucleotide-binding protein G(I)/G(S)/G(O) subunit gamma-2, which in turn is targeted by two distinct compounds: one is a complex alcohol, and the other is a chromenone. Both of these compounds ultimately target the Sodium/bile acid cotransporter. This suggests that Abiesadine J may act through a common mechanism involving the G protein subunit gamma-2, which is a key regulator of bile acid transport. The presence of multiple target compounds with similar molecular profiles further supports the idea that Abiesadine J may interact with the G protein subunit gamma-2 in a manner that influences bile acid transport. The evidence indicates a potential role for the G protein subunit gamma-2 in mediating the effect of Abiesadine J on the Sodium/bile acid cotransporter, though the exact mechanism remains to be fully elucidated.
